title: Deterministic decision-tree depth
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty alphabet, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f : \Omega^n \to \alpha$ be a function. Its deterministic depth is the least depth of a finite decision tree that computes $f$.
